Shared rules for recognisable Standard elements

These diagnostics protect the conventions that make every service contract and architectural element understandable: types have one nature, public APIs use business language, validation and exceptions have explicit boundaries, and peer services do not form hidden dependency chains.

The value of enforcing this family

Start here when a warning concerns a rule shared across several service layers rather than one specialised element type.

Choose a diagnostic below for its Standard references, architectural rationale and practical bad and good code examples.
